title: pvEnSightReader
body:
## pvEnSightReader

Reads an EnSight 6 or EnSight Gold case (.case, ASCII or binary), a post-processing format exported by many CFD and structural solvers (OpenFOAM's foamToEnsight among them). Output is a multiblock dataset with one block per EnSight part, carrying the node (point) and element (cell) variables selected in PointArrays and CellArrays; transient cases expose their time steps. Use pvEnSightMasterServerReader for a parallel .sos master file and pvWriteEnSightWriter to write EnSight.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- CaseFileName must be the .case file; the geometry and variable files it names are located relative to it.
- ApplyTetrahedralize (default false) splits every cell into tetrahedra, multiplying the cell count; use it only to work around non-manifold EnSight meshes.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `EnSightReader`. Identity: `sources/ensight`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ApplyTetrahedralize` | This property set if we want to tetrahedralize the output to prevent non manifold mesh later (generated by the Ensight Solver). | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `CaseFileName` | This property specifies the case file name for the EnSight reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `CellArrays` | This property lists which cell-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointArrays` | This property lists which point-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvEnSightReader",
  "options": {
    "CaseFileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
